title: MZ Better Display of Multiple State Icons in Battle

posts.author: Tamarin
posts.body:
By default, in RPG Maker MZ, when an actor or enemy has more than one state in battle it will be shown as one icon cycling through all the states.  This method, while functional, is not very user friendly, especially for more state heavy games as it often means the player has to wait for the icon to cycle through all the states to see which ones are affecting a specific actor or enemy, which can drag the pacing of a battle.
I am requesting a plugin that vastly improves how multiple states are shown for both actors and enemies by displaying all the icons at once instead of cycling through them, and allows developers to easily modify how and where icons are displayed to fit the needs of their project.  Although I have found a few plugins that change how state icons are displayed in battle, they either don't have all the features I'm looking for or are not compatible with other plugins that also change the look and functionality of the battle screen.
Below are more details on the main features I am looking for, with examples provided.
⦁
Display Icons in a Row
:  The icons for all the states affecting the actor will be displayed in a row on the actor's battle status window.  Developers can adjust several parameters such as the maximum number of rows, amount of icons per row, and the size of all icons. The same can also be done for state icons on enemies, but with a few additional options which will be covered further below.
⦁
Change State Icon Position for Different Enemy Types using Notetags
:  Because enemy sprites come in different sizes, developers should be able to offset the position of state icons for different types of enemies by entering notetags in the database.
Below is an example of how another plugin,
TheoAllen's Enemy HP Gauges
, allows developers to add HP bars for enemies and reposition them using notetags.
The HP bar shown in-game.
Similar functionalities for a state icon plugin would be useful for developers to ensure state icons are displayed consistently for each type of enemy without the icons overlapping the sprite or other elements such as an HP bar.
⦁
Compatibility with other plugins
: The plugin needs to be compatible with other plugins that alter the look and functionality of the battle screen, most notably
Visustella's Battle Core
and its multiple display styles for the actor status and command screens.
Battle Layout Styles from Visustella's Battle Core:
⦁
Display State Icons for Actors Outside of the Default Battle Status Window
:  Developers should have the option to detach state icons for actors from the default battle status window and move them anywhere on the battle screen.  This would be useful for developers who choose to make their own battle hud using a program such as
Hud Maker Ultra
, and leave the default battle status window disabled or hidden.
This feature would mostly be intended for solo-actor games with custom battle huds, but can also be used for games with two or more actors.  If the game has multiple actors in battle and the default battle status window is disabled, developers can have different parameters set for how and where state icons are displayed for each actor.
Below is an example of what the parameters for state icons outside of the default battle status window could look like.
Actor ID:  The ID of the actor the states will be displayed for.
Icon Position X:  The X offset of the state icons for the specified actor.
Icon Position Y:  The Y offset of the state icons for the specified actor.
Max # of Rows:  The maximum number of icon rows for the specified actor.
Max Icons per Row:  The maximum number of icons displayed per row for the specified actor.
Icon Scaling:  The size of the icons displayed for the specified actor.
I believe this plugin would be useful for developers who want to make the display of state icons in battle more user friendly and convenient for the player.  Please let me know if you have any questions.
Other plugins mentioned:
SRD's Hud Maker Ultra:
http://sumrndm.site/hud-maker-ultra/
TheoAllen's Enemy HP Gauges:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/theo-enemy-hp-gauge.133044/
